_comment: The api release this repo REQUIRES: tools.json must be the byte-exact stdout of
`command` run in a checkout of `repository` at `ref`. scripts/check-api-parity.mjs
re-runs it and refuses any difference.
v5.29.0 exports the nineteen-tool surface with create_job's content_aware
describing auto_abr as accepted, and get_usage's hosting_estimated_from. The
export was taken from api 540030fc (origin/master) before v5.29.0 was cut;
confirm the tag contains it before relying on the parity check.
Re-vendoring must read a DETACHED WORKTREE at that tag, never the shared api
checkout, which other sessions commit to and which sits on master:
TRANSCODELY_API_PATH=/tmp/api-pin npm run tools:sync && npm run readme:gen
Better still, omit TRANSCODELY_API_PATH and let the script clone the pinned ref
itself — the only mode that verifies the pin.
